name: Feed plan

entryPoints.label: Pen feed value in the pen header
Feeding block of a pig record

addsTo.what: Pen feed value in each pen header

flow: tap End date or Add note

notes.purpose: Read what a pen is fed today: the formula, how it is delivered, the pen's daily total and each pig's share, then adjust it.
states: Trough or station pen: total plus one row per pig.
Ad-lib pen: see feed-plan.adlib.

elements.name: Title · scope
elements.logic: Pen id and the count of all pigs in the pen.

elements.name: Card · formula
elements.logic: The pen's feed formula name; no brand, supplier or nutrition (see issues).

elements.name: Card · delivery
elements.logic: Label from the pen's feeding mode.

elements.name: Daily feed
elements.logic: Sum of every pig's allowance today: base amount x factor, or the held amount, or 0 if stopped. "Ad-lib" for ad-lib pens.

elements.name: Pig row · ear tag
elements.logic: One row per pig, hidden for ad-lib pens.

elements.name: Pig row · note
elements.logic: Feed tags joined with " · "; "Follow curve" when the pig has no adjustment. Tags: Feed +/-N%, Feed held, No feed.

elements.name: Pig row · amount
elements.logic: The pig's own allowance (base 2.4 x 1.1 = 2.64, shown rounded to one decimal).

controls.does: opens the editor for the pen's pigs
returns to where it was opened (pen sheet)

edge: Pen with mode "unknown": no formula label, pigs show "No feeding plan recorded" on their own page.
rules: Feed is guidance, not a completion checklist: no Record as done, no refill or delivery log (ROUND-3).
issues: The pig row shows the amount to one decimal while the editor shows two (2.6 against 2.64), so the same number reads differently on two screens.
"Formula due" on the walk list has no explanation here: nothing on this page tells the worker what formula change is due or when.
The page shows only formula, mode, kg; the feed brand, supplier and nutrition proposed in ASTRA-FEED-PLAN-FIELDS are not drawn (unclear: whether the pen page or only the pig page should carry them).

screens.name: Pen feeding · ad-lib
screens.zh: 栏位饲喂 · 自由采食

notes.purpose: An ad-lib pen has no daily allowance, so the page says so and the editor is refused.
states: Pen D4 (Grower 1): Daily feed reads "Ad-lib"; no pig rows.

elements.name: Card
elements.logic: Formula and mode.

elements.name: Daily feed
elements.logic: Replaces the kg total.

elements.name: Pig rows
elements.logic: Hidden: no individual ration.

controls.does: opens the editor, which answers "Feed adjustment unavailable · Ad-lib feeding has no fixed daily allowance."

edge: Boars and piglets (animal-types preset) are in ad-lib pens as well.
rules: "Ad-lib formula/timing information is read-only; it creates no feeding-completion event" (ROUND-3).
issues: Adjust feed is offered and always answers "unavailable"; the button could be absent or disabled with the reason.
No feeder low or hopper information is drawn (the Feeder low banner was removed).

notes.purpose: All three pens are ticked: the Actions sheet opens on its Pens tab, whose only rows are Pen note and Feed. Feed leads to the editor for every pig in those pens.
states: Scope switch: Pigs 7 · Pens 3 (the Pens tab is active).
Footer holds only Back; no category tabs on the Pens tab.

elements.name: Title · scope
elements.logic: Count of ticked pens, then of pigs (ticking a pen ticks the pigs shown).

elements.name: Scope switch
elements.logic: Each tab shows its count and is disabled at 0.

elements.name: Row · Pen note
elements.shows: A note attached to the selected pens
elements.logic: Writes the same note to every selected pen.

elements.name: Row · Feed
elements.shows: Adjust daily feed for these pigs
elements.logic: Opens the feed editor over the pigs of the ticked pens; ad-lib pens' pigs appear as blocked rows.

controls.does: opens the editor with the pens' 7 pigs
opens the note form for the ticked pens
switches to the pig actions (Health · General)

edge: Pigs not ticked inside a ticked pen still count: opening from pens captures the pens' current pigs.
rules: The Pens tab offers pen note and feed; a fault needs one pen, so equipment fault reporting asks for a single pen (ROUND-3).
issues: The row is named "Feed" with the sub-line "for these pigs" under a tab called Pens: pens and pigs are used for the same row.
In the Pens tab no row reaches equipment faults though the pen chooser for them is in the code.

notes.purpose: Change the daily feed of one or many pigs (a pen, ticked pigs, ticked pens) in one move: follow the curve with a percentage, hold the amount, or stop feed. How to reach it: the feed value in a pen header, Pen feeding then Adjust feed, Actions then Adjust feed / Feed, or Review feed adjustment on a finding.
states: Follow curve (default): a percentage from -50 to +50 of the base curve.
Hold amount: every pig keeps today's kg as a fixed amount; the percentage box is disabled ("Daily amounts stay fixed").
Stop feed: 0.0 kg/day; the box is disabled ("No feed · 0.0 kg/day").
Mixed: pigs have different factors, the box shows placeholder "Mixed" and the hint "Choose one % for all pigs".
Nothing can be adjusted (all ad-lib, dead or no plan): "Feed adjustment unavailable" and the reason.
Details panel open or collapsed (toggle "Adjustment").

elements.name: Title · scope
elements.logic: Pig count of the target; a pen entry shows its pig count and not the pen name.

elements.name: List heading
elements.logic: Heading, count and column title.

elements.name: Row · ear tag and plan
elements.logic: Pig id and the pig's feed plan (or the pen formula).

elements.name: Row · feed tag
elements.logic: Existing tag. When the pending change will remove or replace it, it is shown struck through with "Removed or replaced on Save".

elements.name: Row · Current → New
elements.logic: Today's allowance and the allowance after the change, up to two decimals.

elements.name: Row · change
elements.logic: New minus current; "Unchanged" when equal.

elements.name: Row · blocked
elements.shows: Ad-lib feeding has no fixed daily allowance
elements.logic: Replaces the numbers for ad-lib pigs, dead sows ("Pig has died") and pigs with no plan ("No feeding plan recorded"); they are never changed.

elements.name: Feeding mode
elements.shows: Follow curve | Hold amount | Stop feed
elements.logic: Select picker; changing it resets the percentage to 0 when mixed or out of range.

elements.name: Adjustment · %
elements.logic: Number input and a slider (-50 to +50, step 5, labels -50% · 0 · +50%) that stay in step. Starts at the current factor of the target (shown only if all share it).

elements.name: Reset
elements.logic: Sets mode to follow curve, 0% and clears the end date.

elements.name: Hint
elements.logic: Changes with mode and validity.

elements.name: Optional chips
elements.logic: Each opens a small editor. Chip shows "Until 15 Sep" or the note text; an x clears it. When one pig is targeted the existing end date and reason are prefilled.

elements.name: Save
elements.logic: Enabled when at least one pig can be adjusted AND (a mode other than keep or a changed end date / note) AND percent is within -50 to +50 AND any end date is today or later.

controls.does: writes the change to each eligible pig, logs one "Feed plan changed" per pig, and returns to the walk list
discards the draft and returns to the entry sheet

edge: Ad-lib pigs inside a selection are listed as blocked and left unchanged.
Percent outside -50 to +50, or blank, disables Save.
An end date in the past is rejected by the date field (min = walk date) and by Save.
Hold amount fixes today's kg; later curve growth no longer applies until it is reset.
rules: The percentage replaces each pig's existing adjustment ("Replaces existing adjustments").
One editor for pen, pigs and pens: only the scope changes.
Save writes "old → new kg/day · +10% of curve · Until date · reason" to the pig's feed changes and to the walk log, category Feed.
issues: Save silently ends the link between a body-condition finding (Thin) and its feed adjustment (the finding stays but feedLinked is cleared); the screen never says so, while Resolve says "ends the linked feed adjustment".
"Follow curve" with 0% and Reset do the same; three ways to go back to the curve (mode, percent 0, Reset).
The default Save reason when no note is typed is the text "Feed plan", which then shows as the reason on the pig's Feed tag.
The scope reads "3 pigs" when opened from a pen header, so the worker cannot see which pen is being changed.
A total-per-pen preview ("Total · kg/day") exists in the code (feedPreview) but is not drawn; the per-pig list is the only check of the pen total.
A "Feed breakdown" sheet exists in the code with no control that opens it.
Percent, slider and mode picker all show the same decision; the slider moves in 5% steps while the box accepts any decimal.

screens.name: End date and note for a feed change

notes.purpose: Optional: until when the change holds, and a free note. How to reach it: the End date or Add note chip in the editor.
states: End date: a date field (min = today, 12 Sep 2026) and Remove date.
Note: a text area and Remove note.
Save is disabled until the value differs from the saved one.

elements.name: Date field
elements.logic: Accepts today or later; earlier is refused.

elements.name: Note field
elements.logic: Free text.

controls.does: keeps the value and returns to the editor

edge: Saving only a note or date turns on Save in the editor even when mode and percent are unchanged.
issues: The end date is held on the pig as a plain date; when it passes, the prototype does nothing (no return to the curve).

notes.purpose: Read one pig's feeding today and the base curve it comes from. How to reach it: View plan in the Feeding block of a pig record, or a pig row on Pen feeding.
states: Curve-fed pig: Feeding block plus Base curve chart.
Ad-lib pig: Feeding block only ("Ad-lib").
No plan: "No feeding plan recorded."

elements.name: Title
elements.logic: Page title and the ear tag.

elements.name: Feeding · formula and context
elements.logic: Context: "Station-fed" for station pens, "Included in pen allocation" for trough pens, "No fixed ration" for ad-lib.

elements.name: Feeding · amount
elements.logic: The pig's allowance today including adjustments; "Ad-lib" for ad-lib pens.

elements.name: Feeding · tags
elements.logic: Tag with the reason after it: the saved reason or the body-condition band ("Thin · mild"); Feed held and No feed carry their own kg line.

elements.name: Base curve
elements.logic: Points are base kg per day around today (sample curve); vertical range = min/max of the points rounded outward by 0.2. Caption "kg/day · before individual adjustments". Hidden for ad-lib pens.

elements.name: Curve source
elements.logic: The curve source is held in the data but not drawn.

controls.does: returns to the pig record or the Pen feeding page

edge: The sample curve is not a claim about real feed; points are made up around the pig's base amount.
rules: Keep the feeding program (the animal's plan) distinct from the feed formula (the product) - ASTRA-FEED-PLAN-FIELDS.
issues: The page cannot adjust anything: the way to change a pig's feed is the pig Actions sheet or a finding, not this page.
Formula, supplier, brand, energy (ME/NE), protein and lysine proposed in ASTRA-FEED-PLAN-FIELDS are not shown; only the formula name.
The Feeding block here repeats the Feeding block on the pig record (same formula, context and amount).

screens.name: On the list · pen feed increased

notes.purpose: Shows how a +10% change on the whole pen reads on the walk list.
states: C1's three pigs all carry factor 1.1.

elements.name: Pen header · feed value
elements.logic: Sum of the three pigs x 1.1 = 8.14, shown to one decimal.

elements.name: Pig rows · feed tag
elements.logic: On every C1 pig; Feed lens count rises to 5.

issues: A pen-wide change is repeated as a tag on each pig row (three identical tags) instead of once at the pen.

screens.name: On the list · pen feed decreased

notes.purpose: Shows how a -5% change on the whole pen reads on the walk list.
states: C1's three pigs carry factor 0.95.

elements.name: Pig rows · feed tag
elements.logic: delta = (factor - 1) x 100, one decimal, sign shown.

issues: Same repetition as the increased state; a decrease is shown in the same neutral tag as an increase.

screens.name: On the list · pen feed held

notes.purpose: Shows how a held amount reads on the walk list.
states: Every C1 pig has a fixed daily amount equal to what it received before the hold.

elements.name: Pen header · feed value
elements.logic: Unchanged from before the hold.

elements.name: Pig rows · feed tag
elements.logic: Tag only; the held kg is in the tag tooltip ("2.6 kg/day · fixed amount").

controls.does: opens the editor (mode shows Hold amount)

issues: "Feed held" does not say how much or until when; the amount is only in a tooltip.
